algebraic_certificate.implication: T*M*S has row h and column h equal to the corresponding identity row/column. Full compensation is rederived as C*S; cleanup and the canonical local profile are regenerated. This finite free-operator identity does not certify native Clifford/phase or complete supplier/outer obligations.

canonical_domain.dyadic_gate_guard: All synthesized scalar coefficients must be dyadic; scale coefficients must be invertible dyadic units. Non-dyadic canonical pairs or unavailable dyadic unit pivots are explicit finite-protocol rejections.
canonical_domain.frame_cap_guard: In downward_cap mode, cap only synthesized output support at the selected hyperplane and propagate the maximal downward meet backward through the literal chain, preserving centre/cut and warp pins and the prelude, while enclosing exact attained forward floors.
canonical_domain.grouping: Hyperplanes with identical eligible output-coordinate sets share one exact nullspace solve. Every seed/provider/mode must cover exactly the unique normals 1..511 and every expected group exactly once before a NULL is possible.
canonical_domain.hyperplanes: All normals 1 through 511 in the 9-dimensional binary frame space, each in literal and downward_cap modes for both gauge44 and extra providers and both seeds.
canonical_domain.nullspace_basis: Sort constraint keys and variable register IDs lexicographically. Choose the smallest remaining variable as pivot, normalize its coefficient to +1; enumerate free columns ascending, set one free coordinate to 1 and the others to 0, then substitute pivots in descending order using exact rational arithmetic.
canonical_domain.pair_normalization: Enumerate canonical alpha/y basis pairs with nonzero alpha*y and divide alpha by that exact pairing, so alpha*y=1. Derive u=alpha*M and v=M^-1*y exactly.
canonical_domain.pair_order: Ascending (support(alpha)+support(y), support(u)+support(v), exact lexicographic alpha vector, exact lexicographic y vector, canonical basis indices). A vector key is the ascending tuple (register,numerator,denominator). Retain the first 8 nonzero canonical pairs per output-coordinate group.
canonical_domain.pivot_order: Eligible H intersect R helper coordinates except 408, ordered by ascending literal terminal-frame rank then register ID. Retain the first 16 pivots for every retained pair.
canonical_domain.seed_effect: Seeds 11031 and 29063 alter task traversal only. Exact bases, pair/pivot selection and resulting semantic hashes/invoices must agree across both seeds.
canonical_domain.truncation: Record full nonzero basis-pair and eligible-pivot counts, retained counts and all truncation. A bounded NULL makes no claim about other bases, linear combinations, pivot choices or global saturation.

controls.baseline: Independently audit both final provider words, forward and dual, all 632 live input columns.
controls.gate: All four seed/provider control tasks must pass before any screen task launches. A failed or incomplete control produces ERROR/TIMEOUT, never a scientific NULL.
negative: Flip the sign of the final output addition of the first published transform; exact paired identities must reject it.
Omit one compensation gate from the first literal stage, regenerate its profile/cleanup and require the independent all-column semantic audit to reject it.
Set the new terminal helper frame to the empty frame; literal frame replay must reject it before a stale profile can supply the reason.
Undercharge the private-buffer count and physical stock by one; the exact buffer/stock binding must reject it.
controls.positive: Replay all nine published inert transform records in their published order from each PARENT word; require equality with the full decoded final WORD. Independently audit the first literal paired stage as well.

imports: Standard library plus existing trusted records.py, pool.py, latest_fill.py, admission.py and hash-pinned wordio.py. The independent semantic auditor is the existing trusted source-pinned PR2679 auditor used by admission.py. No fetched PR executable text is imported or executed.

nominee_retention.compact_inventory: Persist every compact nominal direction, including provider, group, normal, pair, pivot, profile/width invoice, source attribution and semantic word hash. No search candidate is silently discarded by the artifact retention cap.
nominee_retention.decision: Any nominal direction, including unretained/unmatched candidates or locally validated candidates with pending complete allocation/native/physical/supplier/outer admission, leaves G1 EXPLORATORY. Exact complete fill and fresh native/outer admission require a separately registered follow-up. The runner cannot emit PASS merely from local identities.
nominee_retention.matched_identity: Intersect all four seed/provider inventories by (helper, normal, mode, canonical basis indices); require complete same-provider inventories and hashes to agree across seeds.
nominee_retention.retained_artifacts: Persist immutable full WORD, TRANSFORM and CERTIFICATE gzip JSON files for each retained seed/provider nominee. Preserve total, unmatched and truncated matched counts explicitly.
nominee_retention.retention_order: Sort matched identities lexicographically by helper, normal, mode and canonical basis indices; reconstruct and independently audit both provider words for the first 16 identities on both seeds.

pre_execution_statement: No G1 candidate, calibration control, benchmark or experimental computation has been run. Source inspection and AST parsing only preceded this clarification.

protection_interpretation.excluded_helper: 408 is excluded as a new extraction pivot. All emitted output frames have rank 8; the active external rank-7 helper408 lead is excluded.
protection_interpretation.input_H: Live helper coordinates excluding removed helpers, all 82 restored endpoints, start_extra entrances, initial_corrections sources and every register touched in the frozen A prelude. Input shears are inserted immediately after that unchanged prelude at zero frame.
protection_interpretation.output_R: Live non-target coordinates whose literal terminal frame, or attained forward-floor terminal frame in downward_cap mode, lies in the selected rank-8 hyperplane, excluding all 82 previously restored coordinates. An entrance or correction-source coordinate may be used on output if frame eligible; its input interface and source identity remain unchanged.
protection_interpretation.preserved_fields: Entrances, removed helpers, correction-source identities, target/centre cut interfaces, warp records, prelude and all existing endpoint frames remain unchanged. Only A/B/restore scalar gates or downward frame edits, helper_final addition, compensation, report and derived cleanup may change.

resource_failure_handling.errors: ExactBudgetExceeded, unexpected algebraic/canonical assertion failures, key/index errors, infrastructure failures, missing tasks, coverage failures and storage limits propagate to ERROR/TIMEOUT. They are never individual negative candidates or scientific NULLs.
resource_failure_handling.expected_rejections: Only explicit CandidateRejected dyadic synthesis or legal frame-cap guards count as bounded scientific rejections.
resource_failure_handling.provenance: Full original r11 PINS and latest pinned #2917 word provenance are initialized before large preparation so preparation errors retain source attribution.
resource_failure_handling.storage: Compact checkpoint budget is min(100000000, 200000000 - initial existing results bytes - 20000000). The reserve covers final receipts, source archives and at most 16 matched full nominee pairs per seed. Total result-tree bytes, including full nominee artifacts, are checked before receipts and again at finalization against the strict 200000000-byte cap.
resource_failure_handling.timeouts: 300 seconds per pool task and 14400 CPU seconds for the entire two-seed family, including measured parent preparation/orchestration; no solver calls.

scope: Operational definitions and storage/error handling fixed before execution; original registered scientific pass/null bars, seeds and resources are unchanged.
